package sku

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"

	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/az"
	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/types"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/policy"
)

const computeCaptureSubscription = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
const computeCaptureVM = "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/" + computeCaptureSubscription + "/providers/Microsoft.Compute/locations/eastus/vmSizes?api-version=2023-03-01"
const computeCaptureDisk = "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/" + computeCaptureSubscription + "/providers/Microsoft.Compute/skus?api-version=2023-03-01&$filter=location%20eq%20%27eastus%27"

type computeCaptureCredential struct{}
func (computeCaptureCredential) GetToken(_ context.Context, opts policy.TokenRequestOptions) (azcore.AccessToken, error) {
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(opts.Scopes, []string{"https://management.azure.com/.default"}) {
		return azcore.AccessToken{}, fmt.Errorf("unexpected synthetic audience")
	}
	return azcore.AccessToken{Token: "synthetic-compute-token", ExpiresOn: time.Now().Add(time.Hour)}, nil
}
type computeCapturePage struct {
	URL string
	Status int
	Body string
}
type computeCaptureRequest struct {
	URL string
	Path string
	RawPath string
	RawQuery string
	Method string
	EmptyBody bool
	SyntheticAuthorization bool
}
type computeCaptureCase struct {
	Provider string
	Pages []computeCapturePage
	Cancelled bool
	Expected map[string]types.SKUAvailability
	Failed bool
}
type computeCaptureResult struct {
	Entries map[string]types.SKUAvailability
	Failed bool
	Requests []computeCaptureRequest
}
type computeCaptureTransport struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	pages []computeCapturePage
	requests []computeCaptureRequest
	unexpected string
}
func (s *computeCaptureTransport) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	i := len(s.requests)
	if i >= len(s.pages) || r.URL.String() != s.pages[i].URL || r.Method != "GET" || r.Body != nil || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-compute-token" {
		s.unexpected = "undeclared request"
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("compute fixture rejected undeclared request")
	}
	s.requests = append(s.requests, computeCaptureRequest{
		URL: r.URL.String(), Path: r.URL.Path, RawPath: r.URL.RawPath, RawQuery: r.URL.RawQuery,
		Method: r.Method, EmptyBody: r.Body == nil, SyntheticAuthorization: true,
	})
	p := s.pages[i]
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: p.Status, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(p.Body)), Request: r}, nil
}
func computeCaptureClient(s *computeCaptureTransport) *az.HttpClient {
	return az.NewHttpClient(computeCaptureCredential{}, &az.HttpClientOptions{
		MaxRetries: -1, Timeout: time.Second, Scope: "https://management.azure.com/.default", Transport: s,
	})
}
type computeCaptureTripwire struct{}
func (computeCaptureTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("compute capture attempted external network")
}
func computeCaptureTransportCheck(t *testing.T, s *computeCaptureTransport, count int) {
	t.Helper()
	if s.unexpected != "" || len(s.requests) != count {
		t.Fatalf("fixture request boundary: unexpected=%q count=%d want=%d", s.unexpected, len(s.requests), count)
	}
}
func computeCaptureEqual(t *testing.T, name string, got, want map[string]types.SKUAvailability, err error, failed bool) {
	t.Helper()
	if (err != nil) != failed || !reflect.DeepEqual(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("independent source map oracle %s: got=%#v failed=%v want=%#v failed=%v", name, got, err != nil, want, failed)
	}
}


type computeCaptureGateTransport struct {
	inner *computeCaptureTransport
	entered chan struct{}
	release chan struct{}
}
func (s *computeCaptureGateTransport) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response,error) {
	select {case s.entered<-struct{}{}:default:}
	select {case <-s.release:case <-r.Context().Done():return nil,r.Context().Err()}
	return s.inner.Do(r)
}
type computeCaptureSplitTransport struct { east,west *computeCaptureGateTransport }
func (s computeCaptureSplitTransport) Do(r *http.Request)(*http.Response,error){
	if strings.Contains(r.URL.Path,"/locations/westus/"){return s.west.Do(r)}
	return s.east.Do(r)
}
func computeCaptureGateClient(s policy.Transporter)*az.HttpClient{
	return az.NewHttpClient(computeCaptureCredential{}, &az.HttpClientOptions{
		MaxRetries:-1, Timeout:3*time.Second, Scope:"https://management.azure.com/.default", Transport:s,
	})
}

func TestRegionComputeSKUCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("REGION_COMPUTE_SKU_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" { t.Fatal("missing capture output") }
	oldTransport, oldClient := http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport = computeCaptureTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: computeCaptureTripwire{}}
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient = oldTransport, oldClient }()
	blobs := map[string]string{
		"provider.go": "7f71b296d332001ae12e49a021b6fee44f88a970",
		"cache.go": "5be9c158fd38c609b06ffc67537cd07b838fc9d5",
		"restrictions.go": "8d053daf58c7c8a18f39b579e95d4a53f8ebd55a",
		"compute.go": "ee9300e5f8652591fe43121d0973321742ee70e3",
		"storage.go": "b5a3a8d020c8143c64d296d48e8c51ae3b0ca2cf",
		"cognitiveservices.go": "7b3dc63af21f12213004c6e91d9eaaa06c8a2189",
		"sql.go": "1cb1e6430f11476e66e8bbb13bc0cc2ad5e0a43f",
		"../types/types.go": "f9b61fb74075e5a2297be1b898067b8cb047f9b3",
		"../../../../az/http_client.go": "05d85c5a50ee81f088731160020a914af83e1ca5",
	}
	for path, want := range blobs {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		h := sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00", len(raw))), raw...))
		if fmt.Sprintf("%x", h) != want { t.Fatal("source blob changed", path) }
	}
	available := types.SKUAvailability{State: types.SKUAvailable}
	restricted := types.SKUAvailability{State: types.SKURestricted}
	unavailable := types.SKUAvailability{State: types.SKUUnavailable}
	zones := types.SKUAvailability{State: types.SKUZoneRestricted, BlockedZones: []string{"2", "1", "2"}}
	empty := map[string]types.SKUAvailability{}
	vmMap := map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"standard_d2": available}
	cases := map[string]computeCaptureCase{}
	add := func(name, provider, body string, expected map[string]types.SKUAvailability, failed bool) {
		url := computeCaptureVM
		if provider == "disk" { url = computeCaptureDisk }
		cases[name] = computeCaptureCase{Provider: provider, Pages: []computeCapturePage{{url, 200, body}}, Expected: expected, Failed: failed}
	}
	add("vm-single", "vm", `{"value":[{"name":"Standard_D2"},{"name":""},{},{"name":null},null]}`, vmMap, false)
	add("vmss-single", "vmss", `{"value":[{"name":"Standard_D2"}]}`, vmMap, false)
	add("vm-no-trim", "vm", `{"value":[{"name":" Standard_D2 "},{"name":" "}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{" standard_d2 ":available, " ":available}, false)
	add("vm-single-alias", "vm", `{"VALUE":[{"NAME":"Standard_D2"}]}`, vmMap, false)
	add("vm-duplicate-name-last", "vm", `{"value":[{"name":"First","NAME":"Standard_D2"}]}`, vmMap, false)
	add("vm-duplicate-value-last", "vm", `{"value":[{"name":"First"}],"VALUE":[{"name":"Standard_D2"}]}`, vmMap, false)
	add("vm-duplicate-case-name", "vm", `{"value":[{"name":"Standard_D2"},{"name":"STANDARD_D2"}]}`, vmMap, false)
	add("vm-surrogate-text", "vm", `{"value":[{"name":"\ud800"}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"\ufffd":available}, false)
	for _, provider := range []string{"vm", "vmss", "disk"} {
		for name, body := range map[string]string{"empty":`{"value":[]}`, "missing":`{}`, "null-list":`{"value":null}`, "null-envelope":`null`, "null-items":`{"value":[null,{}]}`} {
			add(provider+"-"+name, provider, body, empty, false)
		}
		for name, body := range map[string]string{"wrong-list":`{"value":{}}`, "wrong-item":`{"value":[1]}`, "wrong-name":`{"value":[{"name":42}]}`, "malformed":`{"value":`, "wrong-next":`{"value":[],"nextLink":42}`, "trailing":`{"value":[]} {}`} {
			add(provider+"-"+name, provider, body, nil, true)
		}
	}
	add("disk-name-tier-and-ignored-type", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"Premium_LRS","tier":"ignored","resourceType":"virtualMachines"},{"tier":"Standard_LRS"},{},{"name":""}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"premium_lrs":available, "standard_lrs":available}, false)
	add("disk-location-precedence", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Zone","restrictionInfo":{"zones":["1"]}},{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"NotAvailableForSubscription"}],"capabilities":[{"name":"available","value":"false"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":restricted}, false)
	add("disk-location-unknown-reason", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"unknown"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":unavailable}, false)
	add("disk-first-location-wins", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"unknown"},{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"NotAvailableForSubscription"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":unavailable}, false)
	add("disk-zone-order-duplicates", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Zone","restrictionInfo":{"zones":["2","1"]}},{"type":"ZONE","restrictionInfo":{"zones":["2"]}}],"capabilities":[{"name":"available","value":"false"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":zones}, false)
	add("disk-empty-zone-capability", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Zone","restrictionInfo":{"zones":[]}}],"capabilities":[{"name":"available","value":""}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":unavailable}, false)
	add("disk-capability-mixed-true", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","capabilities":[{"name":"AvAiLaBlE","value":"TrUe"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":available}, false)
	add("disk-zone-empty-string", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Zone","restrictionInfo":{"zones":[""]}}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":{State:types.SKUZoneRestricted,BlockedZones:[]string{""}}}, false)
	add("disk-duplicate-last-state", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D"},{"name":"d","capabilities":[{"name":"available","value":"false"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":unavailable}, false)
	add("disk-unicode-field-alias", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","reſtrictions":[{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"NotAvailableForSubscription"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":restricted}, false)
	add("disk-alias-last-state", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[],"RESTRICTIONS":[{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"NotAvailableForSubscription"}]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":restricted}, false)
	add("disk-invalid-zones", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Zone","restrictionInfo":{"zones":[1]}}]}]}`, nil, true)
	add("disk-null-restriction", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[null],"capabilities":[null]}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":available}, false)
	add("disk-untrimmed-name", "disk", `{"value":[{"name":" D "}]}`, map[string]types.SKUAvailability{" d ":available}, false)
	for _, provider := range []string{"vm","disk"} {
		start := computeCaptureVM
		first := `{"name":"First"}`
		last := `{"name":"Second"}`
		if provider == "disk" { start = computeCaptureDisk; first = `{"name":"D"}`; last = `{"name":"d","restrictions":[{"type":"Location","reasonCode":"NotAvailableForSubscription"}]}` }
		next := start + "&$skiptoken=synthetic"
		want := map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"first":available,"second":available}
		if provider == "disk" { want = map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":restricted} }
		firstBody := `{"value":[`+first+`],"nextLink":`+fmt.Sprintf("%q",next)+`}`
		cases[provider+"-paged"] = computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:[]computeCapturePage{{start,200,firstBody},{next,200,`{"value":[`+last+`]}`}},Expected:want}
		for _, status := range []int{400,403,404,429,500} {
			body := `{"error":{"code":"SyntheticComputeError","message":"fixture"}}`
			cases[fmt.Sprintf("%s-http%d",provider,status)] = computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:[]computeCapturePage{{start,status,body}},Failed:true}
			cases[fmt.Sprintf("%s-later-http%d",provider,status)] = computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:[]computeCapturePage{{start,200,firstBody},{next,status,body}},Failed:true}
		}
		cases[provider+"-later-malformed"] = computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:[]computeCapturePage{{start,200,firstBody},{next,200,`{"value":`}},Failed:true}
		for name, continuation := range map[string]string{"foreign":"https://synthetic.invalid/compute/next","relative":"/compute/next","malformed":"://invalid"} {
			pages := []computeCapturePage{{start,200,`{"value":[`+first+`],"nextLink":`+fmt.Sprintf("%q",continuation)+`}`}}
			expected := map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"first":available}
			failed := name != "foreign"
			if provider=="disk" {expected=map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":available}}
			if failed {expected=nil} else {pages=append(pages,computeCapturePage{continuation,200,`{"value":[]}`})}
			cases[provider+"-next-"+name]=computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:pages,Expected:expected,Failed:failed}
		}
		cycle := `{"value":[`+first+`],"nextLink":`+fmt.Sprintf("%q",start)+`}`
		cases[provider+"-bounded-cycle"] = computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:[]computeCapturePage{{start,200,cycle},{start,200,cycle},{start,400,`{"error":{"code":"CycleStop"}}`}},Failed:true}
		cases[provider+"-cancelled"] = computeCaptureCase{Provider:provider,Pages:[]computeCapturePage{{start,200,`{"value":[]}`}},Cancelled:true,Failed:true}
	}
	results := map[string]computeCaptureResult{}
	names := make([]string,0,len(cases))
	for name := range cases {names=append(names,name)}
	sort.Strings(names)
	for _, name := range names {
		fixture := cases[name]
		s := &computeCaptureTransport{pages:fixture.Pages,requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
		ctx,cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),3*time.Second)
		if fixture.Cancelled {cancel()}
		var provider SKUProvider
		switch fixture.Provider {case "vm":provider=VMProvider{};case "vmss":provider=VMSSProvider{};case "disk":provider=DiskProvider{};default:t.Fatal("unknown fixture provider")}
		got,err := provider.FetchSKUs(ctx,computeCaptureSubscription,"eastus",computeCaptureClient(s))
		cancel()
		computeCaptureEqual(t,name,got,fixture.Expected,err,fixture.Failed)
		count:=len(fixture.Pages)
		if fixture.Cancelled {count=0}
		computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,s,count)
		results[name]=computeCaptureResult{Entries:got,Failed:err!=nil,Requests:s.requests}
	}
	keys:=make([]string,0,len(registry))
	for key:=range registry {keys=append(keys,key)}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	expectedKeys:=[]string{"microsoft.cognitiveservices/accounts","microsoft.compute/disks","microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets","microsoft.sql/managedinstances","microsoft.sql/servers/databases","microsoft.storage/storageaccounts"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(keys,expectedKeys)||Get("MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES")==nil||Get("unknown")!=nil {t.Fatal("independent registry oracle")}
	duplicatePanic:=false
	func(){defer func(){duplicatePanic=recover()!=nil}();Register(VMProvider{})}()
	if !duplicatePanic||len(registry)!=7 {t.Fatal("duplicate registration must panic without mutation")}

	// Cache calls are sequential: ownership mutation never races source readers.
	cachePages:=[]computeCapturePage{
		{computeCaptureVM,200,`{"value":[{"name":" Standard_D2 "},{"name":" "}]}`},
		{computeCaptureVM,200,`{"value":[{"name":"Standard_D2"}]}`}, // VMSS has a distinct type key.
		{strings.Replace(computeCaptureVM,computeCaptureSubscription,"22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222",1),200,`{"value":[{"name":"Other"}]}`},
		{strings.Replace(computeCaptureVM,"eastus","westus",1),200,`{"value":[{"name":"West"}]}`},
	}
	cache:=NewCache()
	cacheTransport:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:cachePages,requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	cacheClient:=computeCaptureClient(cacheTransport)
	cacheResults:=map[string]computeCaptureResult{}
	call:=func(name,sub,kind,region string,want map[string]types.SKUAvailability,failed bool)map[string]types.SKUAvailability{
		ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),3*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		got,err:=cache.GetSKUAvailability(ctx,sub,kind,region,cacheClient)
		computeCaptureEqual(t,"cache-"+name,got,want,err,failed)
		copyMap:=map[string]types.SKUAvailability{}
		for key,value:=range got {value.BlockedZones=append([]string(nil),value.BlockedZones...);copyMap[key]=value}
		if got==nil {copyMap=nil}
		cacheResults[name]=computeCaptureResult{Entries:copyMap,Failed:err!=nil,Requests:append([]computeCaptureRequest{},cacheTransport.requests...)}
		return got
	}
	cacheWant:=map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"standard_d2":available,"":available}
	owned:=call("first",computeCaptureSubscription,"MICROSOFT.COMPUTE/VIRTUALMACHINES","East US",cacheWant,false)
	call("normalized-reuse",computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","eastus",cacheWant,false)
	owned["injected"]=restricted
	mutatedWant:=map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"standard_d2":available,"":available,"injected":restricted}
	call("caller-map-mutation-shared",computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","eastus",mutatedWant,false)
	call("vmss-separate",computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets","eastus",vmMap,false)
	call("subscription-separate","22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222","microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","eastus",map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"other":available},false)
	call("region-separate",computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","westus",map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"west":available},false)
	call("unsupported",computeCaptureSubscription,"unknown","eastus",nil,true)
	computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,cacheTransport,4)
	retryCache:=NewCache()
	retryPages:=[]computeCapturePage{{computeCaptureVM,403,`{"error":{"code":"RetryFixture"}}`},{computeCaptureVM,200,`{"value":[{"name":"Standard_D2"}]}`}}
	retryTransport:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:retryPages,requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	retryClient:=computeCaptureClient(retryTransport)
	retryResults:=[]computeCaptureResult{}
	for i:=0;i<3;i++ {
		ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),3*time.Second)
		got,err:=retryCache.GetSKUAvailability(ctx,computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","eastus",retryClient)
		cancel()
		want:=vmMap
		if i==0 {want=nil}
		computeCaptureEqual(t,fmt.Sprintf("retry-%d",i),got,want,err,i==0)
		retryResults=append(retryResults,computeCaptureResult{Entries:got,Failed:err!=nil,Requests:append([]computeCaptureRequest{},retryTransport.requests...)})
	}
	computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,retryTransport,2)

	// The empty start URL returns an empty map without consulting even a nil client.
	pagerEmpty, pagerErr := FetchPagedSKUs(context.Background(), "", nil, func(item vmSizeItem)(string,types.SKUAvailability,bool){
		t.Fatal("empty URL consulted extraction");return "",types.SKUAvailability{},false
	})
	computeCaptureEqual(t,"pager-empty-url",pagerEmpty,empty,pagerErr,false)
	results["pager-empty-url"]=computeCaptureResult{Entries:pagerEmpty,Requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}

	zonePages:=[]computeCapturePage{{computeCaptureDisk,200,`{"value":[{"name":"D","restrictions":[{"type":"Zone","restrictionInfo":{"zones":["2","1","2"]}}]}]}`}}
	zoneCache:=NewCache()
	zoneTransport:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:zonePages,requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	zoneClient:=computeCaptureClient(zoneTransport)
	zoneMap,zoneErr:=zoneCache.GetSKUAvailability(context.Background(),computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/disks","East US",zoneClient)
	computeCaptureEqual(t,"cache-zone-original",zoneMap,map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":zones},zoneErr,false)
	zoneBefore:=types.SKUAvailability{State:zoneMap["d"].State,BlockedZones:append([]string(nil),zoneMap["d"].BlockedZones...)}
	zoneMap["d"].BlockedZones[0]="changed"
	zoneAgain,zoneErr:=zoneCache.GetSKUAvailability(context.Background(),computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/disks","eastus",zoneClient)
	computeCaptureEqual(t,"cache-zone-shared",zoneAgain,map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"d":{State:types.SKUZoneRestricted,BlockedZones:[]string{"changed","1","2"}}},zoneErr,false)
	computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,zoneTransport,1)
	zoneAfter:=types.SKUAvailability{State:zoneAgain["d"].State,BlockedZones:append([]string(nil),zoneAgain["d"].BlockedZones...)}

	// All caller goroutines are ready behind one barrier before release.
	// This proves bounded same-key dedup/reuse, not exact singleflight waiter entry.
	concurrentCache:=NewCache()
	concurrentTransport:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:[]computeCapturePage{{computeCaptureVM,200,`{"value":[{"name":"Standard_D2"}]}`}},requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	gate:=&computeCaptureGateTransport{inner:concurrentTransport,entered:make(chan struct{},8),release:make(chan struct{})}
	concurrentClient:=computeCaptureGateClient(gate)
	concurrentContext,concurrentCancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),5*time.Second)
	defer concurrentCancel()
	type callResult struct { entries map[string]types.SKUAvailability; err error }
	concurrentResults:=make(chan callResult,8)
	ready:=make(chan struct{},8)
	startCall:=make(chan struct{})
	for i:=0;i<8;i++ {go func(){
		ready<-struct{}{}
		select {case <-startCall:case <-concurrentContext.Done():concurrentResults<-callResult{err:concurrentContext.Err()};return}
		got,err:=concurrentCache.GetSKUAvailability(concurrentContext,computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines","East US",concurrentClient)
		concurrentResults<-callResult{got,err}
	}()}
	for i:=0;i<8;i++ {select {case <-ready:case <-concurrentContext.Done():t.Fatal("concurrent ready deadline")}}
	close(startCall)
	select {case <-gate.entered:case <-concurrentContext.Done():t.Fatal("same key request did not enter")}
	close(gate.release)
	for i:=0;i<8;i++ {select {case result:=<-concurrentResults:computeCaptureEqual(t,"concurrent-same-key",result.entries,vmMap,result.err,false);case <-concurrentContext.Done():t.Fatal("concurrent result deadline")}}
	computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,concurrentTransport,1)
	concurrentObservation:=computeCaptureResult{Entries:vmMap,Requests:concurrentTransport.requests}

	// Two different keys must both reach transport while both responses are blocked.
	separateCache:=NewCache()
	eastInner:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:[]computeCapturePage{{computeCaptureVM,200,`{"value":[{"name":"East"}]}`}},requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	westURL:=strings.Replace(computeCaptureVM,"eastus","westus",1)
	westInner:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:[]computeCapturePage{{westURL,200,`{"value":[{"name":"West"}]}`}},requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	eastGate:=&computeCaptureGateTransport{inner:eastInner,entered:make(chan struct{},1),release:make(chan struct{})}
	westGate:=&computeCaptureGateTransport{inner:westInner,entered:make(chan struct{},1),release:make(chan struct{})}
	splitClient:=computeCaptureGateClient(computeCaptureSplitTransport{eastGate,westGate})
	separateResults:=make(chan callResult,2)
	for _,region:=range []string{"eastus","westus"} {go func(region string){
		got,err:=separateCache.GetSKUAvailability(concurrentContext,computeCaptureSubscription,"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines",region,splitClient)
		separateResults<-callResult{got,err}
	}(region)}
	for _,entered:=range []chan struct{}{eastGate.entered,westGate.entered}{
		select {case <-entered:case <-concurrentContext.Done():t.Fatal("separate keys serialized or deadline")}
	}
	close(eastGate.release);close(westGate.release)
	separateMaps:=map[string]map[string]types.SKUAvailability{}
	for i:=0;i<2;i++ {select {case result:=<-separateResults:
		if result.err!=nil||len(result.entries)!=1 {t.Fatal("separate key source result")}
		for key:=range result.entries {if key!="east"&&key!="west"{t.Fatal("unexpected separate key")};separateMaps[key]=result.entries}
	case <-concurrentContext.Done():t.Fatal("separate results deadline")}}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(separateMaps,map[string]map[string]types.SKUAvailability{"east":{"east":available},"west":{"west":available}}){t.Fatal("complete separate key maps")}
	computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,eastInner,1);computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,westInner,1)

	write:=func(name string,value any){
		raw,err:=json.MarshalIndent(value,"","  ")
		if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
		if err=os.MkdirAll(output,0700);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
		if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output,name),append(raw,'\n'),0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
	}
	write("source-compute-sku-inputs.json",struct{
		Blobs map[string]string
		Cases map[string]computeCaptureCase
		Registry []string
		CachePages []computeCapturePage
		RetryPages []computeCapturePage
		CacheCalls []string
		ZonePages []computeCapturePage
		ConcurrentSeam string
		Seam string
	}{blobs,cases,expectedKeys,cachePages,retryPages,[]string{"first:sub111:VM:East US","normalized-reuse:sub111:vm:eastus","caller-map-mutation-shared:inject restricted; sub111:vm:eastus","vmss-separate:sub111:vmss:eastus","subscription-separate:sub222:vm:eastus","region-separate:sub111:vm:westus","unsupported:sub111:unknown:eastus","retry:403 then success then cached"},zonePages,"Eight ready callers, blocked leader response; separate east/west both enter before release. Same-key result proves dedup/reuse, not exact waiter registration.","Injected supported transport, fake credential, MaxRetries=-1; does not certify production retries/live deployment"})
	write("source-compute-sku-outputs.json",struct{
		Cases map[string]computeCaptureResult
		Registry []string
		DuplicateRegistrationPanics bool
		Cache map[string]computeCaptureResult
		Retry []computeCaptureResult
		ZoneBefore types.SKUAvailability
		ZoneAfter types.SKUAvailability
		ConcurrentSameKey computeCaptureResult
		ConcurrentSeparateKeys map[string]map[string]types.SKUAvailability
	}{results,keys,duplicatePanic,cacheResults,retryResults,zoneBefore,zoneAfter,concurrentObservation,separateMaps})
}
